title: Pumpkin's hitmarker
description: A hitmarker mod for those who want to know when they this works with every mob, player and any weapons
body:
A lightweight hitmarker mod that lets you know whenever you successfully land a hit.

Unlike many hitmarker mods, this one works with **every mob, player, weapon, and damage source** in Minecraft 1.21.1. Whether you're using a sword, axe, mace, bow, crossbow, trident, your bare fists, or virtually any item capable of dealing damage, the hitmarker will appear on a successful hit.

The mod also fully supports **all arrow types**, not just standard arrows, ensuring consistent feedback regardless of your ammunition.

For added flexibility, the hitmarker system is **fully configurable**. You can choose to display hitmarkers for:

* All weapons and damage sources
* Projectile weapons only (bows, crossbows, arrows, etc.)
* Or customize the behavior to suit your preferences

Simple, lightweight, and highly compatible, this mod provides instant visual feedback for every successful hit.
